title: Bound what may be ingested
description:
**Phase 6 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** eef4aa
- **Runs in parallel with:** ac3b7a and 14cf05
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The five consequential classes are an egress taxonomy inherited from a household, where the only question was what leaves. In an organization, authorizing the ingestion of a reference is a real standing that some members have and others do not, and it is also the primary attack described in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md. TaskCapabilityGrant.origins and EgressClass.APPROVED_ORIGIN_FETCH carry half of it already. Make ingest a class a ceiling can bound, not only a grant field.

Serialization via parse_grant_table/grant_to_payload/grant_from_payload + HTTP PutTurnGrantBody. 4 new pytest (506 total). Pure pytest, no Gherkin (per AGENTS.md BDD rule).
